case.question: Any footy clubs near Brunswick I could join?
case.note: 'footy' is not a vocabulary name; /sports?q=footy returns nothing, so the model must find Australian Rules Football.

result.answer:
I found five upcoming Australian Rules football programs in the wider area, though none are in Brunswick itself. Distances are straight-line from the centre of Brunswick.

The closest is the Reclink Footy Cohealth Kangaroos program at JJ Holland Park, South Kensington (about 4.8 km). It runs free on Wednesday mornings. The publisher's records show an accessible toilet, parking and change facility about 130 to 134 m away, with the toilet data last updated 2022-01-12.

The AFL Victoria Wheelchair Auskick Centre (Sundays, mornings, paid, at State Netball Hockey Centre, Parkville, about 2.2 km) has no published access information. Two more programs (Reclink Footy Collingwood Magpies and Salvo Hawks) are further away. Check with each venue about access and joining.

Two more programs are listed in the search. Open the search page to see them all.
